A '''Talz pilot''' applied for membership in what became [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] founded by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. The [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was rejected due to becoming emotionally unstable when placed in simulated combat environments.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>
